pages.text: Energy cells, your power piggy bank, come in three tiers: basic, advanced, super — capacity goes sky-high as you climb.$(br)Your base can lack walls, but the grid can't lack these.
The Energy Cell Serializer: arrange 26 cells into a 3×3×3 and let them "fuse" into one behemoth.$(br)Total capacity explodes, so say goodbye to the nightmare of "power low" warnings.
The portable cell is a power bank for your backpack.$(br)Carry it to auto-repair akaishi gear, right-click to check the juice — it's your lifeline when you head out to roam.
